name: Josh Allen

background.fact: Born May 21, 1996; grew up on a 3,000-acre cotton farm near Firebaugh, California, a town about 40 miles west of Fresno, where his family has lived since his great-grandfather settled there.
He graduated from Firebaugh High School in 2014, got no Division I scholarship offers, and started college at Reedley College before transferring to Wyoming.
In high school he also starred in basketball and pitched in baseball (fastball up to 90 mph), and he worked on the family farm and at his mother's restaurant.
Buffalo drafted him seventh overall in 2018; he has led the Bills to seven playoff appearances and five straight division titles.
He was named NFL Most Valuable Player for 2024 and is the NFL leader in quarterback rushing touchdowns.
Listed at 6 ft 5 in, 237 lb, age 30, in his ninth NFL season.

family.fact: His paternal grandfather started the family farm in 1975 and served on the local school board; the Firebaugh High gymnasium carries his name.
He married actress and singer Hailee Steinfeld on May 31, 2025 in Ventura, California, after a relationship made public in July 2024 and an engagement announced November 29, 2024.
The couple announced in December 2025 that they were expecting, and Steinfeld announced the birth of their daughter in April 2026. Nothing further about the child is recorded here.

scouts_read: Allen is healthy and set to start, so the main question is how Buffalo wins, not whether he plays. The Jets are 2-7 with a weak secondary, and Buffalo is a touchdown or more favorite with a team total near 29 points. Allen's 2026 profile leans on rushing touchdowns, which keeps his floor high even when his passing is quiet, as in the 12.9 point game at Minnesota. If the Bills lead early, Cook may take more of the work and trim Allen's passing numbers. I would project a solid game in the low to mid 20s with a real chance of a 30 point day.
